title: Song Hye-kyo, Gong Yoo's 'Tantara' premieres Dec. 11 on Netflix
summary: The South Korean period drama "Tantara," starring powerhouse duo Song Hye-kyo and Gong Yoo, will premiere on Netflix on December 11, the streaming giant announced.
